sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has type-1 mandibles and differs from the other species of this type in the denser short hairs over the surface of the head capsule.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Sides of the head parallel in dorsal view. Dorsal tubercle slightly prominent in lateral view, situated behind the lateral projection. Mandibles type 1, with a tooth-like process at the middle. Short hairs fairly dense over all surfaces of the head capsule, with scattered setae. Postmentum with short hairs and setae. Pronotum with short hairs and the margins with setae; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with setae; abdominal tergites densely setose and with short hairs, the sternites with short hairs and erect setae on the posterior margin.
